import datetime, json, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
b=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root=b.parent.parent
compilers={name:len(subprocess.run(['pgrep','-x',name],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()) for name in ('ninja','cmake','clang','clang++','cc1','ld')}
start={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'compiler_processes':compilers,'load':os.getloadavg(),'scope':'Explicit recorded shared-load measurement, not clean-host acceptance. Compiler counts are saved before each timed child. Other workloads may bias comparisons.' if '--record-shared-load' in sys.argv else 'Shared interactive host; no compiler processes observed at start.'}
(b/('blocking-preflight-'+str(__import__('time').time_ns())+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(start,indent=2)+'\n')
if any(compilers.values()) and '--record-shared-load' not in sys.argv:
 print('Preflight rejected; benchmark not started:',compilers)
 raise SystemExit(2)
if (b/'blocking-measurement-start.json').exists():
 raise SystemExit('Preserve existing measurement start')
(b/'blocking-measurement-start.json').write_text(json.dumps(start,indent=2)+'\n')
command=[sys.executable,str(b/'benchmark_cpu_shared.py'),'--baseline',str(b/'baseline'),'--baseline-label','24b020353','--candidate',str(b/'blocking-candidate'),'--candidate-label','764661385','--pairs','15','--output',str(b/'blocking-comparison.json')]
with (b/'blocking-comparison.log').open('x') as log:
 result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
